a.lede: If you've bought an iPhone in the last couple of years, you might be eligible for a cut of the class action lawsuit. Here's how to file your claim.
a.title: How to get your cut of Apple's $250 million Siri settlement

b.lede: Apple may pay out up to $95 for each eligible iPhone purchased by someone who felt misled about Siri’s release. You have until December 21 to submit a claim.
b.title: How to Claim Your Cut of Apple’s $250 Million Siri Settlement
